content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

The sovereignty of your digital commerce infrastructure is paramount when platforms like PayPal and Stripe are inaccessible. By utilizing NOWPayments for Bitcoin transactions, you drastically reduce fees from 10% with platforms like Gumroad to just 0.5%. This means for every 100 sales at $97 each, you retain an additional $921. With automated systems in place, you gain unparalleled control over your sales process, ensuring immediate payments and product delivery directly to your customers.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before diving into setup, ensure you have a few key components ready: a domain name for your store, a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting, and a NOWPayments account for processing Bitcoin transactions. You’ll also want your ebook files and any required metadata prepared for upload. These elements are essential to create a streamlined and effective sales process that operates without the typical restrictions found in traditional platforms.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying your chosen infrastructure. For a straightforward setup, use GitHub Pages for hosting your website. Integrate Google Apps Script to handle backend logic, which will automate product delivery upon payment confirmation. Connect your NOWPayments account for Bitcoin processing, ensuring that your pricing is dynamically adjusted to USD at transaction time. This configuration allows you to manage everything seamlessly, providing buyers with instant access to their purchases.
Lower fees mean more profit for you.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your setup is complete, it's time to go live. Promote your ebook through social media channels or your existing audience. When a customer makes a purchase, the NOWPayments webhook will trigger the delivery of the ebook immediately. Monitor your payment notifications and ensure everything operates smoothly. If you encounter any issues, review your configurations and consult the documentation to troubleshoot efficiently.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial transactions, focus on scaling your operations. Analyze customer feedback and adjust your offerings accordingly. Consider adding more products or variations to your ebook catalog. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access additional blueprints and templates that enhance your sales process. This approach not only diversifies your income streams but also solidifies your presence in the digital marketplace.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Instant delivery enhances customer satisfaction.

The Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all the tools you need to build a sovereign digital commerce stack, ensuring you’re fully equipped for success. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for instant downloads.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

Not at all. By following straightforward deployment steps with GitHub Pages and NOWPayments, you can have a fully operational store up and running quickly.
